mapper.select: SELECT o.order_id, o.member_id, o.order_date, o.order_status, o.total_price, o.delivery_addr, m.name as memberName, m.id as memberLoginId, (SELECT i.item_name FROM item_order io JOIN item i ON io.item_id = i.item_id WHERE io.order_id = o.order_id LIMIT 1) as firstItemName, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM item_order io WHERE io.order_id = o.order_id) as itemCount FROM orders o LEFT JOIN member m ON o.member_id = m.member_id ORDER BY o.order_date DESC
